description: This file defines a data source class 'NiaPreferencesDataSource' responsible for managing user preferences using Android's DataStore in a Kotlin-based Android application. It includes methods for updating and retrieving user preference data such as themes, followed topics, bookmarked news resources, and onboarding visibility.

classes.name: NiaPreferencesDataSource
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and updating user preferences stored in DataStore, including theme settings, followed topics, bookmarked news, and onboarding status.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Updates the set of followed topic IDs in user preferences.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Sets the followed status for a single topic ID.

methods.name: setDynamicColorPreference
methods.description: Sets the user's preference for dynamic coloring.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or unbookmarked.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a specific news resource as viewed.

methods.name: setNewsResourcesViewed
methods.description: Marks multiple news resources as viewed.

methods.name: getChangeListVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the current change list versions for topics and news resources.

methods.name: updateChangeListVersion
methods.description: Updates the change list versions with a provided update function.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Sets whether to hide the onboarding flow.
